tools.name: get_conveyor_status
tools.description: Return cached last Arduino acknowledgement. No serial writes; NOT measured belt state.

tools.name: start_conveyor
tools.description:
Physically start conveyor via Arduino relay D7. Keeps running after client disconnect.

        Invoke only following an explicit operator command or approved control decision.

tools.name: stop_conveyor
tools.description: Send relay OFF and await Arduino acknowledgement. Does not measure physical stopping.
